scenarios.name: What boards for kitchen cabinets
scenarios.last_reply:
For kitchen cabinets, 16mm White Melamine Chipboard is the standard choice for the internal carcasses because it is durable, hygienic, and great value. For the exterior doors and panels, our HDS-manufactured melamine boards come in a variety of stylish solid colors and wood grains! 

What look or style are you envisioning for your kitchen?

scenarios.last_reply:
